subject: Trading
title: The Stoic Trader
description: A 60-second lesson on The Stoic Trader.

hook.text: Marcus Aurelius led Rome through plagues and wars with calm discipline. Stoic philosophy applies perfectly to trading.

buildup.text: Stoicism teaches: control what you can (your actions), accept what you can't (the market), and know the difference.

discovery.text: You can't control whether a trade wins. You can control your entry criteria, position size, and exit rules.

twist.text: Emotional neutrality—neither euphoric in wins nor devastated in losses—is the Stoic trader's superpower.

climax.text: The best traders look bored. They've internalized that individual outcomes don't matter—only the process does.

quiz.question: What can a trader control according to Stoic philosophy?
options: Their own actions—entry criteria, sizing, and exit rules
